name: Servo
description: RC servo control for CH32V-family RISC-V microcontrollers, built directly on ch32fun. Two interchangeable pulse-generation backends selected at build time: TIM2 hardware PWM (up to 4 servos, no interrupts at all) or a SysTick compare-match backend that consumes no general-purpose timer, leaving TIM2 free for the rest of your firmware. Optional interrupt-driven smooth motion needs no polling from your main loop. Integer-only, no dynamic allocation, no Arduino core, no HAL.
